name: pdf-form-batch-fill
description: Fill one blank PDF form for every row of a roster (CSV/XLSX): map fields once in a side panel, place text boxes on forms without fields, check for missing values and text that overflows, then generate one PDF per person plus a merged file and a report. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Fill one blank PDF form for every row of a roster (CSV/XLSX): map fields once in a side panel, place text boxes on forms without fields, check for missing values and text that overflows, then generate one PDF per person plus a merged file and a report. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用一张名单（CSV/XLSX）批量填写同一份空白 PDF 表单：在侧栏里映射一次字段，没有表单域的 PDF 可直接在页面上拖出文字框；先检查漏填和文字超出，再为每个人生成一份 PDF，可另存合并文件和检查报告。全部本地处理，无需 API 密钥。

fontPath.title: 中文字体文件（可选）
fontPath.description: 可选。填写内容使用的字体文件（.ttf/.otf/.ttc）完整路径。默认自动查找系统中文字体（macOS: Arial Unicode / 冬青黑体，Windows: 黑体 / 微软雅黑，Linux: Noto CJK）。
